name: ReferencePanel
description: Panel body content for viewing candidate reference letters. Two states: Read (letter has been opened) and Unread (not yet viewed). Shows the reference letter document viewer on the left and metadata/actions on the right.

modal-left.note: Modal(Browser) showing the reference letter document

section-right.note: Metadata: sender, date, status; action buttons

metadata.note: Right: sender info, date, status, actions

do: Mark as Read once the letter is viewed.
Allow downloading the reference letter as PDF.
dont: Don't allow editing the reference letter content.
